verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for a product-analytics and automation platform like PostHog, but the pack documents no version history, review step, or rollback for automations. Feature-flag kill switches and reviewing agent-generated pull requests are adjacent features, not automation version control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
